text:
incident-bot: PAGER: auth-proxy detected anomalous outbound activity -> s3://external-logs-9f4b. 401 spike on auth-validate route + large PUT volume in last 4m. severity: high. paging arun (oncall).

arun: acked, logging in now. anyone see customer-facing errors? :eyes:

jess: jumping in — checking proxies and egress rules. starting quick triage.

priya: tagging sec for visibility. add legal if data could be exfil. recommend immediate service-account key rotation for relay-ingest.

emily: support on standby. do we need an incident bridge/customer hold?

jess: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -l app=auth-proxy -o wide` shows 3/3 running. Logs show repeated 401s from same svcacct header and a different user-agent: `curl/7.74.0 (suspicious)`.

jess: found outbound host: s3-external.redwood-uploads[.]com (resolves to external-bucket IPs). config shows an old forwarder env var pointing to that bucket.

priya: ok, block egress to that bucket immediately. apply temporary denylist at egress gateway and revoke relay-ingest keys.

arun: applying firewall rule now -> `egressctl deny host s3-external-redwood-uploads.com`

arun: rule applied, dropped traffic to bucket. monitoring counters falling. :white_check_mark:

jess: running key rotation plan for relay-ingest: 1) create new key, 2) update forwarder, 3) revoke old key. doing step 1.

priya: hold — before revocation, snapshot logs for forensic. set retention freeze. sam looped in for evidence preservation.

sam: legal here. preserve raw logs and do not purge anything. we may need to inform affected customers depending on scope. please add a timeline doc.

emily: support: preparing a hold message for customers if we confirm exfil. what's current scope?

jess: initial parse: ~9k objects PUT in 4m, mostly small telemetry files. metadata contains IPs and some debug headers. looks likely staging keys were rotated into prod env var earlier today during deploy. investigating which deploy.

priya: if staging tokens were used in prod forwarder, high chance of PII in payloads. rotate keys now, then run scrubbing pipeline for any replicated logs in external bucket.

arun: completed rotation: new key created and deployed to forwarder config. old key disabled.

arun: `curl -I https://s3-external.redwood-uploads.com/health` now times out (blocked). forwarding stopped.

jess: kicking off scrub job to redact PII and list objects to delete in bucket. will coordinate with ops owning the bucket (external vendor).

priya: open task list: [1] preserve logs (legal) [2] rotate keys (done) [3] block egress (done) [4] scrub/delete exfil bucket contents (in progress, vendor reachout) [5] customer impact assessment (support) [6] postmortem owner?

emily: support to map customers by affected tokens: running query against auth logs to list tenant IDs. ETA 30m.

sam: legal: keep comms repo. no external statement until we confirm scope. prepare internal timeline + FAQ for support.

jess: preliminary root cause: stale forwarder config pointed to external bucket; the deploy earlier today accidentally promoted staging env var. adding CI guard to prevent env var bleed.

arun: handing off oncall to jess in 15m for follow-up and cleanup. anyone object?

priya: ack handoff. will stay on for remediation coordination.

emily: support will keep monitoring channel. drafting customer notice template (internal only).

jess: will own the post-incident ticket and follow-up actions (CI guard, better key TTL, egress monitoring rule).

arun: thanks team. closing pager. will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
